_comment: Open wheel positions. Written by the /wheel skill (and by hand); read by the skill and by the Stock News Digest routine for its wheel alerts. The wheel is a position LIFECYCLE, so this ledger is what makes exit rules and portfolio limits evaluable at all — without it every session starts blind.

_schema.wheel_capital_usd: account size x max-deployed %. Every '% of wheel capital' limit is measured against this.

positions[].leg: csp | shares | cc — the CURRENT leg of the cycle
positions[].cycle_started: YYYY-MM-DD — the date the first CSP of this cycle was sold
positions[].contracts: integer, negative not used; shares = contracts x 100
positions[].strike: current short strike (null while holding shares with no call written)
positions[].expiry: YYYY-MM-DD of the current short leg (null if no short leg open)
positions[].credit_received: per-share credit on the CURRENT short leg
positions[].assignment_strike: price shares were assigned at (null before assignment)
positions[].premium_collected_total: per-share sum of every credit this cycle, net of debits paid on rolls
positions[].commissions_total_usd: dollar total, all legs this cycle
positions[].net_basis: assignment_strike - premium_collected_total - dividends_received_total + commissions per share. RECOMPUTE on every update; the CC strike floor depends on it.
positions[].rolls_this_leg: integer, max 2 before accepting the outcome
positions[].collateral_usd: strike x 100 x contracts while in the csp leg; shares at cost after assignment
positions[].thesis: one line — why you are willing to own it
positions[].invalidation: the specific event that voids the thesis and breaks the wheel
